customer_name: Xuzhou XCMG Excavator Machinery Co., Ltd.
business_problem: XCMG Excavator needed a unified industrial data foundation to support product innovation, fault prediction, risk control, and smarter operations as the business scaled beyond what fragmented data and ad hoc analytics could support.
solution_summary: XCMG Excavator built its industrial data platform on Baidu AI Cloud's Tiansuan stack, combining EasyDAP, BMR, Sugar BI, PALO for Apache Doris, and Pingo. The platform was designed as an end-to-end open data environment that covers data integration, governance, development, analysis, service delivery, and visualization. EasyDAP acts as the data-lake and integration layer, BMR supplies managed big-data services, PALO provides an MPP warehouse for multidimensional analysis, Sugar BI renders operational views, and Pingo supports unified batch-and-stream data processing. Together these components let XCMG define data standards, aggregate data from multiple business domains, create marts iteratively, and expose applications for finance, investment, risk control, product innovation, and intelligent services. Instead of treating industrial data as a by-product, the company turned it into a shared decision and analytics platform for both internal management and broader value-chain optimization.

data_flow: Business and industrial data is standardized and aggregated into the Tiansuan platform, where EasyDAP manages ingestion and governance, BMR and Pingo process the data, PALO supports multidimensional warehouse analysis, and Sugar BI exposes dashboards and reports for finance, risk, operations, and product scenarios.
